description: An interface extending JpaRepository whose implementation Spring Data generates at startup, with no class written by hand.
A query Spring Data builds from a method name such as findByLevelAndTitleContaining, validated when the application starts.
An annotation that gives a repository method an explicit JPQL or native SQL query, bound with named parameters.
The annotation that marks a @Query as an update or delete, which runs directly in the database and bypasses the persistence context.
A query result limited to chosen properties, expressed as a record, an interface with getters or a dynamic class parameter.
A predicate built in code over an entity that can be combined with and and or to filter by optional criteria.
A :name placeholder in a query that Spring Data binds from the method parameter of the same name, so no string concatenation is needed.
